notes: gateMaxPx2 7,898 = the first torture-gate measurement (WP-G, 2026-09-25: 6,582 px² masked, 6 components) + 20 % (Peter #16), provisional until G-2 and H re-set every ceiling (plan §11). The area is two cells: the radial gradient (PptxRender's radial fill is not the browser's) and the double outer shadow, whose second layer page.js `shadowOf` drops because PowerPoint draws one outer shadow per shape (warned since plan §16 #19: 'box-shadow: 1 extra outer shadow dropped').
assertion can name a coordinate. No text anywhere: the shape count is the whole point.
'per-side-borders' is the only cell that is more than one shape per div — background plus one thin
shape per side, 5 in total, because the four sides differ: the solid top and left are join polygons,
the dashed right and dotted bottom stroked lines. Uniform borders stay a stroke.
'overflow-clip' is 2 shapes: the container and its oversized child, the child carrying
clip = {x:430, y:390, w:160, h:60} (the container box intersected with the child box).

gateMaxPx2 7,899 = max(measured x 1.2, measured + 60) over the measured 6,582 px2 masked non-chart area on fidelity-w3 (2314d7f), 2026-09-25 (plan §11; Peter #16: measured + 20 %, with the 60 px2 per-slide noise tolerance as the floor). A regression guard, not a target.
